top_strength: Strong logistics discovery—Chauntelle gathered all seven key details (property types, floor/stories, room counts, walking distance, big items, special considerations, and access conditions) methodically and confirmed unit numbers and parking specifics, which directly supports estimate accuracy.
coaching_note: The call skips the entire value prop and promise framing in Section 1, abandons concerns discovery in Section 2, and omits all of Sections 5 and 7 (Two Promises and explicit ask for business)—this reads as an incomplete intake rather than a sales call, leaving no commitment or next-step clarity with the customer.
